actions: Verified frozen clean role control and continued only from own neuroscience state plus public sources.
Ran a 24-hypothesis online Kalman source-decomposition audit over a,rho,Q,S with explicit identifiability abstention and source swaps.

Ran a paired action-dependent partial-observation restless-bandit audit using per-arm four-state Bayesian source posteriors and a source-derived CAUSE index; compared oracle, forced MAP, posterior BMA, semantic abstention with shared fallback, always-shared and regime-only controls.
Stress-tested intermediate Gaussian, Student-t5 and centered-lognormal skew observation families.
Searched public web/GitHub for CAUSE author code/independent reruns and retried read-only SPLiT supporting-code discovery without mutation.
Persisted immutable role-local result and CAS-updated/read-back LATEST.

outputs.key_result: Abstention eliminated confident semantic reversals in matched online/source-swap probes and cut forced-MAP regret sharply, but did not beat the always-shared fallback; skew misspecification reintroduced 2.77% confident semantic reversals, so Gaussian posterior confidence is not a sufficient identifiability certificate.

termination: runtime checkpoint after substantive new result; frontier remains nonempty
blocker: CAUSE author simulation code and SPLiT S1 ZIP payload not recovered through current read-only transport; posterior-predictive misspecification layer not yet built.
exact_next_action: Add online posterior-predictive alternatives for Gaussian, Student-t, skew and correlated-burst residuals; abstain on material out-of-family evidence; test unseen mixtures/scale drift, then rerun the same partial-observation CAUSE comparison. Require near-zero confident reversals, acceptable change latency, and a statistically resolved regret gain over always-shared/base before connecting to genuine O(Nk) dormant-memory tracking.
